memory_update.text: No US-listed pure-play CTC, paper-insulated copper conductor, or HVDC transformer winding-wire supplier was confirmed in this pass; evidence is stronger for non-US-listed KSH International and large OEM customers.
HTHIY should be retained as a reference anchor for HVDC transformer OEM demand and potential supplier-qualification mapping, not as an underfollowed alpha candidate.
HMDPF is an underfollowed transformer-manufacturer candidate, but direct HVDC winding-component exposure remains unproven and needs product-level verification.
ESE/Doble is a plausible testing-and-qualification adjacency for transformer bottlenecks; verify whether its tools are embedded in HVDC transformer acceptance and commissioning workflows.
PLPC is not a winding-component company but may serve as a qualified-grid-hardware analogue and second-order transmission buildout beneficiary.

node: HVDC transformer winding components, continuously transposed conductors, and qualified grid-OEM inputs
summary: Layer 1B expands the investable universe around HVDC transformer winding inputs and qualification-dependent grid-OEM supply chains. For US-listed exposure, the cleanest reference anchors are large-cap HVDC transformer OEMs or grid-equipment leaders, while the underfollowed lane is weaker but potentially interesting: transformer makers, transmission hardware suppliers, and transformer testing/diagnostic vendors that benefit from grid buildout, long qualification cycles, and utility/OEM procurement friction. No US-listed pure-play CTC or paper-insulated copper conductor supplier was confirmed in the provided evidence; pure-play evidence currently appears stronger in India via KSH International, which is not US-listed.
